args.summary: Following the rollout of v2.3.1, checkout-api began failing health checks in production. Mitigation: rolled back all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to the most recent healthy release, v2.3.0. Rollback completed and verified. Root cause of v2.3.1 failure is under investigation; note that v2.3.1-rc also showed unhealthy in staging prior to this.
args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
All done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Reviewed deployment history** for checkout-api: the latest deploy, **v2.3.1**, was unhealthy in production (and its release candidate v2.3.1-rc had already been unhealthy in staging). The most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.

2. **Rolled back all production regions** (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to **v2.3.0** — the rollback completed and was verified.

3. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001), which paged the on-call engineer, documenting the failing health checks after the v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback to v2.3.0, and that root cause investigation is still needed.
